name: The Promenade at Westlake
description: The Promenade at Westlake is an upscale open-air shopping center located in the heart of Thousand Oaks' Westlake Village area. Featuring a curated mix of premium retailers, dining establishments, and professional services, this center serves the affluent Conejo Valley community with convenient access and ample parking. The property's Mediterranean-inspired architecture and landscaped walkways create an inviting destination for shopping and leisure.
summary: An upscale open-air shopping destination in Westlake Village offering premium retail, dining, and services to the Conejo Valley community.
